Thanks again for the call last week. Procurement here — attaching our latest SLA draft and a short Q&A sheet so legal has context before the redline session. We'd like to run a live redline triage with your legal and procurement teams to walk our suggested changes and lock a small set of open items.

Proposed slots (PT):

- Wed 30 Jun, 09:00–09:45 PT (12:00–12:45 ET) — we can compress this into 45m if helpful.

Elena — thanks for the materials, I reviewed both attachments this morning. Quick thoughts and a proposal:

1) Timebox: for initial triage I recommend a tighter 30–45 minute "scope triage" to surface high-risk clauses and agree which items need clause-level redlines versus commercial follow-ups. We can then schedule a follow-up 60m deep-dive for anything that remains contested.

2) Proposed (PT) alternatives that work on our side: 
- Tue 29 Jun, 11:30–12:00 PT (30m) — our engineering/legal can join for the first 30m to confirm impact on telemetry/data flows.
- Wed 30 Jun, 09:00–09:45 PT as you suggested (45m) if you prefer a single session.

3) Suggested agenda (30m):
- 0–5m quick intros + scope
- 5–20m top 3 high-risk clauses (you to highlight)
- 20–30m decide next steps & owners for clause-level edits

4) Participants we propose: Vivek (sales/technical lead), Laura (legal lead), Marissa (onboarding/ops). If Samir will join for security items that would be helpful — otherwise we can sync separately with your security team.

Please confirm which slot and whether Samir will be on the call. If you confirm Tue 11:30 PT I’ll send the calendar invite and pre-read link.
